text: Great Burger...amazing Po-Boys...but the garlic fries are the best. Good price for the amount of food you get!  And the service is excellent.

I'm sorry to do this but this place has gone down hill so fast within 3/4 yrs. so sad.

Everytime... EVERYTIME (4 times) the wings were dry as can be. Even if you ask pleaseeee do not over cook the wings they were dry last time... no dry wings.

The pizza is like the dough changed and it really isn't tasty. All you taste when you bite into it was sauce. Like canned tomato sauce it's sad bc this place was my go to.

As previous reviews mention, Ellington's offers a great happy hour menu! Prices are awesome, with food options for $5 and cocktails for $7. If I was only reviewing drinks, this place would've been easily 5-stars. The Rosemary Collins and Cucumber Gimlet were both dynamite. 

What is lacking was the food.. which could've easily just been what we ordered. The Hot Chicken Deviled Eggs were pretty much just boiled eggs with a spoon full a chipotle mayo on top. The center of the egg was not mixed as you would expect with a traditional deviled egg.  Could've been a personal preference, but it just wasn't good. We didn't order any additional food items so I'm not sure if other items are better. 

Hard to judge the atmosphere during COVID, but I would expect summers to be really cool with their outdoor space.  I'd recommend definitely checking out the happy hour drinks and other food items, the prices really make it worth stopping in.o
The food was exceptional. The servers were spot on in all their recommendations. The presentation was even better!
PSA - they have closed down ..... so try out Bakersfield or Oscar's taco bar......on Tuesdays, the cerveza jack bar next door has $2 tacos, if that works for you.....

Well the first time I order I order online got there to pick it up they never check there online ordering system so it wasn't done that was a order of mussels and wings.
Now the other  night I called on the phone gave my name and number placed my order which was the seafood combo.I then ask about how long the lady tells me 25-30 min ok.but wait she was suppose to call me when it's done.So I sends my daughter to pick it up guess what they gave my order to someone else so my daughter waits another  30mins for them to make it again and when she got home with it.I couldn't even eat it because it was way to salty. A whole waste of 52.00 dollars.Never ordering from there again.

The worst customer service I have ever had in my life.... the two girls working behind the counter need to terminated immediately. I do not suggest this place unless you feel like being treated like a fool.

Best wings hands down! A good place to get a cold beer or my favorite...a Moscow Mule! For how crowded they get, the service is right on! We never have an empty drink. Ok, let's talk wings. Get the flavors mixed.  My favorite is the medium mixed with garlic parmesan! Mmmm so delicious!
Great place to eat breakfast was amazing. Service was great. Will deff come again. Coffee was on point

We are new to the area and went there for the first time last weekend for our anniversary. From the service to the food, it was outstanding. Our waiter was very informative and overall really nice. We can't wait to go back.
I think this restaurant is a little overhyped. We ordered burgers and they were just ok.
If I could give zero stars I would. Will not be coming back for a very long time. How hard is it to give the customer what they want? Evidently pretty hard.

YOU NEED FOOD EDUCATION ON CROSS CONTAMINATION AT THIS KRISPY KREME      STAT!!!
I purchased donuts through the drive-thru and was surprised at what I encountered.  Why on earth would you use the same gloves to collect my money.  Leave those same gloves on and pick up the doughnuts.    I had already paid for the doughnuts and told the person attending to the window that I could not take those.  They were CONTAMINATED.  I explained the above scenario she threw the doughnuts down and walked away.  I drove away no doughnuts--I had wondered if someone had served her like that would she eat them.  Unfortunately, we must all remember what AMERICA is going through.  Even in a non-PANDEMIC event I would have not wanted the doughnuts.  In today's world we need to be more cautious about how foodservice people are serving us.

Love Panera but this location absolutely sucks with the curbside pick up. They take forever to bring the order out. I've used it tons of times and tried to give the benefit of doubt but it's a consistent issue.

I ordered delivery and perhaps I ordered the wrong thing but the General Tsos chicken and fried rice was very plain. No flavor whatsoever. The egg rolls were mushy l. The crab rangoons were just okay. I'll be trying somewhere else next time. 
The only positive was the delivery was very quick~ 30 minutes.

My husband and I took one bite of our pepperoni slices and immediately high-fived. The crust is super thin. It was really crispy when it came out. However, while sitting it got soggy. I suppose that should be expected. The sauce was full of tomato flavor and not excessively seasoned with garlic or onion. Best pizza in my adult memory, for sure better than Serial Grillers. Classic NY pizza by the slice that (don't hurt me) may even beat out Ray's. If my husband goes missing, I'll know where to find him.

Regular roast beef dressed no mayo, small sweet potato fries, and a Barq's fountain drink. Russell's is the prototypical New Orleans roast beef. Stewed until it falls apart and usually requires several napkins. My wife prefers the shrimp PO boy as a non-meat eater because the shrimp are small like popcorn shrimp and the batter is full of flavor. To be perfectly honest I've eaten here probably one thousand times in my life and over 97% of the time I order roast beef. My family lives all over the US now and when they come in Russell's is literally a must!

WOW!!! The food here is really good but the drinks is what made everything stand out. Rex at the bar gave the most phenomenal service I've ever had in my life. Not only is he extremely knowledgeable about drinks but the man knows his food! The descriptions on all the items he gave on the menu made him sound like an expert Michelin food critic! We first started with the watermelon bruschetta which was very interesting and tasty and then Rex convinced me to get the scallops and my husband got the meatloaf Wellington. They both were amazing, the chefs here definitely know what they are doing and have great attention to detail. We were unsure on what drinks to get so Rex asked us what we like and made us a drink he thinks we'd like and OH MY GOD! My drink was PERFECT! I wish I took a picture of it but was just enjoying the moment. I never write reviews but I just had to say Rex is this restaurants VIP all-star. So please, come here get some amazing food and drink recommendations from Rex. You won't be disappointed, I promise.

Poor customer service on drive thru it is ridiculous they don't take separate payments  in one car! They want us to drive back again for the other order! Totally poor customer service! I will never come here! I don't  even want to recommend this fast food to my friends!

Brunch here is subpar. The ricotta at was too bitter and avocado toast was a little salty. Everything else we ate was good though. Probably give the food a 2star. The reason that they get a 4 star review is the service is excellent. Everyone here is super nice and accommodating. The host was awesome! All the servers who helped us were great. Not ruling this place out completely, going to try again for dinner just because the service is impeccable.

This was the best Chic Fil A service I've ever received. The staff here really know how to tend to the needs of their customers. While waiting on a really long line at the drive through, staff members were able to come up to the windows of cars with iPads to help place orders to speed up the waiting process. We were able to get our orders in no time because of this! Super efficient !

Worst delivery man experience ever- extremely argumentative and lazy. I live in a high rise building with ample free temporary parking. The delivery man called me and said he had the delivery in my lobby and when I asked him to bring it up, he said "I'm not a bike delivery man, I don't do that". There's ample parking and he says he didn't care he wasn't doing it. I then called the restaurant and they didn't seem to care, so I called Grubhub and they said the delivery man works for Little Italy. Also the food was 30mins late, past the quoted delivery time. I'll never order from here again.

This place was delicious. 
I am not sure how long this place has been opened but it seemed pretty new. 
I went during lunch time with a couple coworkers. Took a while to get the food due to the fact that only one person was making the food that day. 
Will definitely go back.

Stopped by for lunch maybe should have ordered only get 30 min so my time is precious stood waited no one in line ? Waited ? No one even said will be with you ? Nothing waited some more thanks for wasting 1/4 my lunch and not even ordered   ? Sweet never again
Straight stole my money and never delivered my food. Hate that I didn't first read these reviews. Never ever order from this place.

Food was delicious! We got the cheese board, pork belly and beef rib apps, and French onion soup. We also had one of the specialty cocktails. That was really good too! Definitely going back to try the bone marrow app and one of the enticing entrees. Service was excellent. Check out this hidden gem! You won't be disappointed.
Great Thai food. I would definitely recommend! I love the vegetable rolls and crab fried rice

I'm a little late on this review, but visited NOLA BEFORE all the unprecedented health crisis . That said, I want to give Pascale's a SHOUT OUT so when things return to normal, you'll come enjoy a special meal here!!  Overall 4.0 rating, excellent food and service!  Entrees were not inexpensive, but worth the experience, so expect to spend around ~$20-30pp. 

For us, it was a special Birthday celebration, and heard about their BBQ Shrimp specialty.  Pascale's has served Louisiana style Italian culinary dishes for over 100 years!  We enjoyed fresh oysters, gumbo, daily fish entree specials, Crabmeat and Scallops seafood pasta, tasty homemade key lime pie and good drinks.  All were flavorful, plentiful and filling!

Outside the downtown area, in a mostly residential neighborhood, you can take a short Uber ride there, and reservations are recommended.  

Ambience was tablecloth dining, well lit dining room and suggest proper or Smart casual attire.  Check out Pascale's, it's a legendary place.  Enjoy!

TL/DR - food was 3.5 stars, service was 1 star at best. Doesn't live up to the hype

--

Was super hyped to get to check out Emeril's, as I grew up hearing BAM and thought this would be the culinary centerpiece to a wonderful trip to New Orleans. Boy was I wrong. 

We had an 830 reservation for 4, us and another couple. Upon arriving they were not ready for us so we had to wait 5-10 minutes. They said to wait at the bar but a) we didn't really want to drink and b) there were no spots for a party of 4 to sit at the bar. Not sure if it's typical to wait when you have a reservation but I wouldn't think that's the expectation at a restaurant ok this supposed caliber. 

We then are seated and our server greets us and is barely understandable. We take a few minutes and then finally get ready to order. For whatever reason the vibe we got was they would not take our order until we ordered wine, but oh well. We placed our wine order and ordered house salads and an app. We wait about half an hour, no salads no apps and then they just come out with our entrees. .... .... ....

We awkwardly look at each other like "what is happening" and the take another few minutes to flag down our ghost of a waiter. The manager comes over and just says "desert is on us."  This is odd because we wanted to get our apps and desert wasn't really something we planned to get anyway. 

A few minutes later the manager comes back and understanding what happened finally, tells us that they will be out with our s
Always amazing chargrilled oysters and wonderful service! Food quality and cost are in line!
Get the cinnamon roll you will thank me later!! Just a fun place!! It is a Boise must!

The food is average, the service is average the atmosphere  is average.  What kind of place reserves all the bar seats for dinner people?  You can barely get a drink from a bar with open seats that can't be used.  Really dumb set up. I say avoid this place because it is just average and dealing With the whole every bar seat is reserved is just a pain. Go to Big Fish, bigger more engaging bar. Same price point but has MUCH better happy hour fare and the food was very good and better portioned.
The best food and customer service! Me and my line sisters were in New Orleans for our reunion and decided to try Morrows. The food and drinks sooooo good! Definitely will be back

I was excited to try this place given the reviews. However, I was disappointed with the quality of the food. Unfortunately, the food was bland and it tasted as it had been reheated versus cooked fresh. The other frenchy by the beach serves better quality in food and drinks.

This chicken was some of the best I had while in NOLA. On a late night or anytime you want a little snack this place fulfills your needs. Not only do they have good chicken but the frozen daiquiri machine drinks are great too. There are several tasty flavors that they let you mix & match & you can get it in a cute little container to keep. The fries are just ok & greasy but perfect after a night of partying. The chicken is very well seasoned & I didn't even need sauce for my chicken fingers. I'll definitely come again.
Wow this place was so good.  Nice clean restaurant that appears to be family run.  All the dishes were well prepared and very flavorful.  The lamb was delicious!  We will be definitely be back.

Hmm....

Great sandwiches
Great customer service
Patient employees
I got a free cookie one time
Took my B1G1 coupon on my previous receipt no problem and told me that the one that's printing out is a little different as a heads up

No complaints, I'm happy with this location and how they're running it!
Great fried  chicken and sides, from a clean and  efficient restaurant. As good or better  than any thing  else local. We shall visit again for sure.

What a cute, little quaint restaurant in Ewing, Nj. It appears that they are still only hosting outdoor seating, but we didn't mind! It was set up quite well- the tent had several fire pits that kept us warm on a 60 degree night. 

The service was immaculate- Cole was a really nice server. They also had a young lady clearing everyone's dishes and bringing bread. She was also very sweet! 

We ordered two appetizers (the Brussels sprouts and crab dip). Both excellent, fresh, and full of flavor. 

For dinner we ordered the scallops in blush cream sauce with lobster mashed potato's (yes. You're reading that correctly) and short ribs. Both amazing. 

We can't wait to return here. Only concern: some of the food came out cold. But we didn't complain- it was yummy enough!
Great place to eat , great food and excellent service , always very attentive and efficient.
My favorite Szechuan place in Chinatown! And now it's newly renovated and looks gorgeous and gladly food and prices have stayed just as great! Can't wait to go back, a little addicting!

I was in my tourist vibes making my (many, many) laps around the market and I made my way to Sang Kee Peking Duck! I ordered a box of the Shrimp Dumplings and they were amazing! Cooked to order, and I paid and was out of the way onto the next restaurant in no time.
I find this Bar amazing.  Service is good, food is good and always have a great time there with friends.  I find that they are neither racist nor homophobic, they are American and proud of it.

I love the southern v. It is truly incredible the food they make without dairy and meat. I consistently recommend people go here if they want good southern food! Their chicken biscuit and biscuits and gravy rival any in the city and their chicken and waffles might make you become vegan on the spot. They have a fresh selection of pastries that change weekly and their donuts are borderline life changing. I don't think there is a thing on this menu that is not perfection! If you are in search of a meat and three without the meat- look no further than the southern v!
Amazing food it tastes so good. The waiters were pretty nice, but it took a while to get served.

Marieanne is one of best bartenders.  The beer selection is great, great craft beer selection and always cold!! They always have the "game" on the multiple t.v.'s.  If you are looking for a chill environment to
watch some sports and drink some good craft beer Brixx is a good choice.

Stopped in Cappy's because of the reviews and I am new to Tampa so trying places out.

I started out with a water and then ordered a Cappy deep dish chicago medium pizza.  Menu says expect a wait of about 30 minutes and thats is about what it was. 

Pizza was good and I had plenty to take home.

Others have commented how the service was great - mine was so-so.  Once I sat down, the waiter got me my water and took my pizza order. The place wasn't very busy at all - maybe 3-4 booths, he brought me my pizza when it was ready but that was about it. Never asked if I needed a water refill or if I wanted something different to drink - which I was considering .  Dropped off my bill as he walked by the table and picked it up when it was ready but no real interaction.

Like I said the pizza was good -- maybe an off night for the server.

Delicious delicious delicious! 
Highly recommend stopping by this location for brunch, the eggs Benedict, to die for. Licked my plate
My parents and I come here often for the round-eye steak pho and crispy spring rolls. Food is amazing, and the owner is wonderfully personable. My boyfriend and I also do date nights here!

I used to highly recommend this place until we went this past Saturday evening. Service was terrible and it took 1.5 hours for us to get in and out. We also had kids. Thankfully they were on their best behavior. Manager wasn't phased by our concerns at all either.
Oh my God, Lucky's Last Chance was outstanding. Despite the location, the prices weren't crazy. Everything we ordered tasted great. The team is extremely pleasant as well. It's perfect.
Excellent find in Boise! Authentic imported staples from Middle Eastern cuisine. From delicious knefe, kebob, cheese, canned and jarred delicious essentials and more!

this shit is so fuckin disgusting. i pulled up expecting real tacos you know i got excited being mexican and all when i heard the word tacos. but i knew something was up when it was  located in downtown. i walked in and they made me act like i was at school writing down my taco on a paper. it's kinda like subways choose yo own system but i chose the flour tortilla and they didn't even warm it up in any form. it was cold. and the music... wasn't even mexican music. they gave me a cold taco with only salsa verde and onions. smh. really disappointed. ain't comin here again

I have only been once so I will need to return to make a proper review but I wanted to put something out as I was impressed. They have several happy hour/ brunch specials and probably the best queso in Nashville. Yes they are a seafood place but their queso is absolutely incredible. I also tried the shishito peppers which were great, along with misc drink specials that were also amazing. The place is considerably larger than I anticipated, and has a massive bar. I will write a more thorough review on my next trip, but rest assured it is worth a visit!

Had a nice celebration here for my friend who just successfully defended her PhD. Parking is an hour free in the nearest garage. Their Margarita is so good, especially the seasonal blood orange one, strongly recommended! Got the fat boy basket with queso. Their queso is a must-try! The whole lunch is really fulfilling and satisfying. We really enjoyed our time here.

We really enjoyed this place.  A neighborhood bar type atmosphere, good food, cold drink.  Good wings says the hubs. We had 2 small kids and they were very accommodating. Also had nachos and tots ...both good.
One of my favorite places to bring my friends. Real, authentic Indian food that never disappoints! Lots of vegetarian options.

I highly recommend Joe's Next Door for your sandwich fix! I spent this last summer working my way through the menu, trying all of their hot sandwich offerings. My favorite is the Evan's IPA Braised Beef sandwich. They scoop out some of the bread from the ciabatta bun in order to make more room for the huge amount of tender and tasty beef. The havarti cheese is melty and pairs perfectly with the caramelized onions. El Cubanito is a close second choice. The pork is tender, the ham is salty, but the Garlic Mustard Butter brings this hot sandwich to the next level. Every other sandwich I tried was delicious. I can tell the chef took much consideration for flavor pairings and proportions, as each sandwich is balanced with harmonious ingredients. If the Chicken Torta is calling your name, I advise swapping out the Challah Roll for a crustier bread option. The bun didn't hold up well to the juicy pulled chicken and salsa, but the flavors were mouthwatering.

Lastly, you can't beat the service at Joe's. The sandwich-makers are friendly and professional. I have been continuously impressed with their safety protocols during COVID-19 and have always felt safe and cared for when I walk through their doors. Make sure to stop in and try Joe's- you won't be disappointed.

What can I say about this place besides, the cook really put his foot in it! If you like seasoning and want to support a Black Own Restaurant, you gotta go to Maxine's. They have private parking, and everything from the Mac&cheese to the Rice & gravy was cooked so Bombly! They have homemade ice tea & lemonade, incorporating some vegan options would be life. 

The restaurant itself could use some flavor,. live the atmosphere up a bit.. maybe bring back the plants, decor the plain walls with some nice Black Paintings and maybe replace the old school paper table mats. 

Not worth of losing a star (but still salty behind) you have to request their special butter and cornbread which we did but they had ran out of a couple of days before we came. Ya should make sure to always have this stable on deck! This what stands ya out and I hope next time ya are fully prepared. 

Also, it's a Black restaurant and not hearing soulful / r&b music just didn't sit well. The silence just didn't feel right. Would've loved hearing some soul music while Maxine's fed my soul. Definitely would recommend before or after visiting Madam C.J. Walker Building or The Black Center of Literature and Culture inside the Central Library only minutes away.
Amazing!! The staff are great the food is phenomenal and overall just a great vibe. I 10 out of 10 recommend coming here! You won't be disappointed!

Pulled up at 11pm to get food Togo and they had a full dining room of guest but the doors were locked? Three employees looked at us through the door and made eye contact with us and smirked and turned away. Very unprofessional and flat out rude.. won't be visiting here again...
Place is dope, staff are friendly and helpful and drinks are always cold and a great variety of beer. Food is good and the venue has a nice chill atmosphere with great live music
We love coming here anytime we are in town! Great staff and food is delicious! Local hangout with a great bar and outdoor seating! A must try while in Eagle, you won't be disappointed!

Fantastic coffee shop in Southwest Boise! Unique, mouth-watering coffee/tea selections that will leave you wishing for a refill at the last drop. The food is delectable! Don't forget to check out the shop. You're sure to find a mindful gift that will make you smile. For all it offers, it's contribution to such a wonderful cause pours out of each and every aspect. This space, the food/drinks, handmade gifts, art, amazing music, community outreach and genuinely good people, will keep me coming back frequently. Thank you for the good vibes, Awakenings!!

Amazed!  Full disclosure, this place makes for a great happy hour.  

We chose to sit inside at a tall table in the bar area on a Friday night in July because it was rather warm outside.  The bar was closed due to Covid, otherwise we love to belly up on a normal day.  

The server was calm and sweet, he let me taste the wine before deciding which is always nice.  Pretty quick to choose a nice COLD glass of sauv blanc from the happy hour menu and a shot of whiskey (or two).  

I had already done my research and asked the Yelp crew a question regarding Rattlesnake's happy hour.  To my surprise, Dave the owner replied ever so kindly and now I was even more excited to try them out.

Dave started waiting on us, I asked if it was him who responded to the Yelp question.  He offered to bring us freshly baked bread with freshly whipped homemade butter.  I don't usually eat butter on the regular, but this was hands down delish and it was a night out, so duhhh!  I knew I wanted the polenta and shrimp.  Thankfully my date is typically easy going and doesn't care too much about what we order.  I loved everything so much I could go on and on, but you get the idea.  I will forever dream about those firecracker shrimp cups.  

They have their own greenhouse so all of the produce is grown on premises, I believe.  The butter lettuce was so bright green and super fresh.  

This place is now on my list for one of the best happy hours in Reno.  I cannot wait to try the full menu for dinner!
Delicious! The bowls are fresh and the service was amazing. I highly recommend this place.
Still Good!!!!!!!!!  Haven't been in awhile. Everything was delicious!! I got the same order as before except this time I got spinach instead of the green beans. The spinach was flavorful and good.

We love this restaurant - phenomenally large menu, great service, food is delish and plentiful portions.  I recently had the halibut and it was devine.  The pizzas are great as well.  And of course, who doesn't love BYOB!!
Just discovered this place and it is amazing . Such a fantastic experience for a long wait. I highly recommend.  My go to at the airport.

Food in the time of Covid: Eating out these days can be a whole thang and I'm so glad to say that Little Saigon cafe makes it like a walk in the park: Great take out and safe service, good food, and lovely packaging. 

Now, on to the food: 
- I got the Chef Special: Bun Ca Chien Cha Gio: It was the right combination of meats, veggies, vermicelli, and egg rolls. The portions were big - which mean I had more to eat for my next meal! And the reheat was still good. 
- My eyes were hungrier than I were, so I also got the Banh Xeo. I did not eat this immediately, but heated it up over the pan for the next meal and boy it was hands down the best Banh Xeo I had. And this was after re-heating it over the stove top!! 
- Papaya salad on the side with some yummy protein on top: I promise I'm not a glutton but the options here were all so healthy and tasty that I don't feel bad at all scarfing these down! The vegetables were fresh and crunchy, went really well with the sauce and the well marinated and grilled meat. 

Side note: They are also selling masks at a very good rate if y'all are running low on those! 

Overall this was a great experience for take out - And I look forward to more from Little Saigon!

This will be one of our new favorites in Reno. The vibe, atmosphere are really cool. Food and cocktails are great too. Not the same ole stuff you see. Menu Had everything from oysters, lamb, rabbit, tacos and more. Haley our server was awesome too.

Super delicious Chinese food. I had the egg foo young and my BF had a variety of apps plus the spicy chicken. Wow!! I can't wait to go back and try more. It is take out only b/c of the Covid issue but they are just down the block from us and a welcomed addition to our neighborhood.

Disappointed. Been here before and it was great. But how time's have changed. The beer's are still great but the food......... big disappointment.  I'm sorry. What we had was either mushy or way overcooked,  too dry. We we will try again.
Killer is right! The pork belly was delicious! Highly recommend for a quick lunch as your cruising around The French Quarter.

I'll lead with the positives. They were prompt to get us seated in the socially distanced seating. The staff was friendly and quick to fulfill requests for specific jams for our toast. 
Then our food arrived. The chicken fried steak was sorely disappointing. Two small nuggets, prepared from frozen stock, and then partially covered by some okay gravy. Eggs, toast, and hash browns that accompanied it were okay, but the centerpiece of the meal was underwhelming. 
The corned beef hash was good-sized and adequate, not quite as richly flavored as I have had in the past here.

This place is an instant classic. Def recommend. The birria tacos at Monsters hot dogs are absolutely delicious and authentic. They also have raspados, pizza, fried chicken and a bar. It's a cool vibe and people there are friendly.

Food: Great food always seems to be on point.

Ambience: Two words, dark & grungy!! I've never gone there and it wasn't. I don't believe the establishment has ever been updated since it opened (which has to be at least 15 years). Other than the food there's nothing Caribbean about the place.

Waitstaff: They are ok.

Restrooms: D


For a first date, it would be a no-go, but been together for some time It's okay.

The service was quite good, but the food was fair. I ordered a beef noodles and the soup was like water. And the wonton with spicy oil is sour due to the vinegar which is not for me. Overall it was ok.

We went here so my boyfriend could get an Italian beef. We both ended up getting sandwiches and WOW!! The "whole" order for a sandwich is two sandwiches!! Super delicious. We ordered pizza from them the next night and it was even better!
This location only hires rude, unprofessional people. The poor service has happened to me on multiple occasions. Zero people skills.
Love this restaurant!  Great place to meet friends. Food is different and delicious. Great drinks. Loved having Karissa as our server.   Erin was so great to us. Have the churros for desert!

Had Uber delivery. Sub standard quality. They charge the same price but give you a smaller portion even if you pay for an upgrade. You ask for soup you get a salad.  When you call to complain they just tell you to eat what you got.  Stay away from this place.  Nuke a TV dinner and save your $$$.

This place surprisingly is pretty good, but a little on the pricey side for serving pizza, salads and pasta. I ordered the pasta and meatballs and my wife ordered a pepperoni pizza in thin crust. We also ordered bruschetta as an appetizer, which was actually phenomenal! I originally pegged The Hub in downtown Tucson with the best bruschetta, but I think Sauce has them beat. 

The pasta with meatballs was okay, although the meatballs tasted like there was just an ungodly amount of oregano in them, but other than that, all good. The thin crust pizza wasn't bad either. The cleanliness of the restaurant was great and the staff are abnormally friendly, which is a stretch for this side of town. 

Overall, 4 stars and 1.5 thumbs up for this place. We'll be back another time and hopefully our experience is just as good as the first!!

This restaurant is said to have some of the freshest seafood in the STL area.  Inside is beautifully decorated and perfect for a quiet, romantic dinner.  The service was excellent as our waiter took time to explain the various dishes.  Keep in mind this is a upscale restaurant and the prices do reflect that.  We started with the American Hacklebach Caviar and Littleneck Clams.  For our entrees we ordered the Atlantic Swordfish and Atlantic Striped Bass with some additional sides - Wild Mushrooms and Black Truffle Creamed Spinach.  All the food was cooked perfectly and absolutely delicious.  With drinks our bill totaled ~$185.00 for two people.  However the restaurant does have a Happy Hour for food and drinks (4:00-6:00 bar & patio area) and $25.00 off if you download their app.  With these perks it's certainly worth a visit.

I drove by this place for years before I went to eat there (pre covid). I felt like we were the youngest folks there (which isn't a bad thing!).  It is super family friendly and feels cozy in there. The food was reasonably priced for what it was. 
It could be a bit updated on the inside. I'd go again!
Was a stop on our food walking tour through the French market. The moufaletta was amazing! The white sangria was also excellent!

5 star brunch menu!!!
I've been to a few $30-$50 buffet style brunches and this place has the best. And if you want bottomless Mimosas or Bloody Mary's they have that for an extra $11... steal!

This is my go-to weeknight date spot in the neighborhood. This past Wednesday we had $1 oysters, some small plates and cocktails/wine for Happy Hour. HH was also extended all evening, which was lovely! The oysters and wine I had where spectacular - my husband had a burger and cocktail along with oysters, which where also excellent. 

I grew up in Maryland, so fresh seafood is a staple for me and the nostalgic memories. Aether is a unique and welcome add to the neighborhood! Looking forward to Wednesday. 

8/19

Great dim sum. Even my parents (Chinese immigrants) agreed that the food was pretty authentic. Prices appear to be a tad more expensive compared to other places. We enjoyed all the dishes (siu mai, dumplings, soup dumplings, scallion pancakes, vegetable tofu soup, sticky rice in banana leaf, etc). However, I personally do not like egg tarts or pumpkin tarts much (as an American-born Chinese person, I enjoy American desserts more and find a lot of sweet Chinese desserts to be somewhat weird to my palate!). I also actually did not like the turnip cake, which was surprising; I liked it at other places, but here, it tasted weird and too hard (and the accompanying sauce was too sweet/weird for me). Maybe it was just a miss, or they made the turnip cake differently from other places (I'd prefer other places' recipe!).

I'm not much of a beer drinker but the food is reason enough to visit. The hubby loves Stout and tells me this is the place. I just had steamed buns and cider and loved every bite. His banh mi disappeared too fast for me to steal a bite. He reports that it was phenomenal.
I see more visits in our future.
Happy to report that they are now wearing mask and gloves at this location during coronavirus. I'm very glad they are taking the health of their employees and customers seriously.

My sisters and I meet monthly for dinner & drinks and June was Francesca's turn. The service was ok and drinks came pretty quick after ordering. I was disappointed with the baked penne. It was not baked as per the menu. It was boiled with sauce & cheese. For $15, it was not worth it though the sauce was good as well as the cheese. Regular spagetti was $9 on the menu. Two sisters ordered chicken parm sandwiches and they were happy with them. My other sister ordered Italiano Panini with no onions. It came out with onions. She sent it back and the replacement came out as we were finishing our meals so she took it to go. Also, they used a plain pizza dough for the bread, kind of thick for a panini. Just not the same as the old Vince and Tonys.

We have come here many times over the years. We have enjoyed the Chimi Supreme and several other chimis. Our favorite dish in recent months is the Las Palmas Special. It is basically really good mixed fajitas (steak, chicken, and shrimp) with peppers and onions served over rice (no tortillas) covered with queso and cheddar cheese. Their rice is the best we have ever had - it is a cilantro rice (so it looks green) and is particularly good in this dish since it absorbs the queso cheese. Things have changed a bit throughout the years here, but this is still a place we enjoy the food very much!

Food and service was excellent.  Our server was Christina and she was able to change my partner's catfish from fried to blackened.  Food was hot fresh and flavorful. 3rd story dining deck is something to see.  Only complaint is it was a chilly night and they ran out of gas for the heaters.

Waited over 45 minutes for a pizza they never started the order
Staff very rude
Did get a cash refund even though I wanted it on my card
Will never return

FAST DELIVERY! We had never heard of this place. It popped up online as one of the few places open on Christmas night with delivery. We ordered our pizza and it was at our door piping hot in 21 minutes. The bbq pizza is way better than papa johns! We were very impressed with the food we ordered and will definitely give this place repeat business!

Came here on a recommendation from my brother in law while we are up visiting for Christmas.  One of the best breakfasts we have ever had.  Eggs Benedict with sausage was perfect.  Country skillet and western skillets were perfection and all was way too much food.  Service was outstanding and very pleasant.  Will definitely visit again when we are up in town.

We are new to Dunedin, arriving 6 weeks before Quarantine and we have been back to Clear Sky multiple time because of their delicious menu options, (we've never been disappointed) and their strict adherence to Covid-19 rules. 
So far we have enjoyed the Fish Tacos, Meatloaf dinner, and the classic Hamburgers. Can't wait to go back and try more!

Got the Little Italy pizza.  It had fresh ingredients and was well made....I thought it was decent/ok but I prefer a thicker crust...that being said I'll give them 5 stars still...the goat cheese salad was fresh and the cheese was real good....friendly worker in store.
This place is the bomb. Thin chewy crust... savory sauce.. thin Chrissy pepperoni. Legit

My guy and I are visiting his parents in Dunedin and they told us this sushi place was an absolute must do, and Pisces did not disappoint! Everything we tried from the beautiful Kani Salad wrapped in avocado, to all the different sushi rolls were phenomenal! They have a great happy hour that includes some yummy bites from 4-6 and for hospitality workers, such as myself, the happy hour runs all day on Tuesday! Eric was the bartender who took care of us and he was friendly, knowledgeable and helpful. Excellent service! We will definitely be back when we come up this way again!

Getting straight to the point, this was maybe the best meal I've ever had. We rented out one of their semi private dining areas for a small wedding reception. Everything was perfect, the appetizers, drinks, main courses, and desserts were all fantastic. Everyone in our group was impressed and still talks about The Capital Grille months after we were there. My wife and I will definitely be back soon.

Love the hot dogs and stuffed baked potato but the taco meat seemed very bland. I know you are supposed to add toppings and they have a great choice of toppings but if you just add onion and cilantro like you find them in Mexico the taco is bland and greasy. Still love this place and will go back for sure. Good service, good atmosphere.

Can you give a restaurant a 5 star review based on just their street corn? I hope so, because I just did. Interesting take and a staple street food that is unbelievably tasty. Tacos are great, queso dip is delicious and mixed drinks are done very well. But that corn man, that's why we keep going back.

Excellent food. 
An Absolutely the best chopped liver in town.

I just ordered dinner from them via Doordash- honestly not impressed at all- the only positive is the food arrived ahead of schedule. It was barely warm and 1/3 of my order was wrong. The "tacos" (literally soft mini size taco shell slapped with triangles of pre-packaged sliced cheddar cheese with a hunk of not even warm bbq meat- they gave me two of two taco type when I ordered 1 each of the 4 types offered on the menu) are mediocre at absolute best. Will not be eating here or ordering from here again.

The food here is very delicious, the chicken tortilla soup was my favorite dish, the chicken pieces were big and the soup tasted fresh.

These guys are definitely good at rotisserie chicken, the customer service is excellent and the staff is very friendly.

The place is clean, they have many games for small children if you have kids to keep them busy while you enjoy a delicious meal.

The dining area is clean, bathrooms are clean too, the seats are comfortable.
Stopped on for dinner. We were greeted cheerfully.   And seated in the bar. The decor is spot on and the food was  amazing.  Great job start to finish. We will be back for seconds soon!

Our first time and we were so impressed! The dining room was decorated nicely, clean and spacious. Our servers was very attentive to us and knowledgeable about the menu and even offered to customize rolls if there was something we didn't like. All of our nigiri was super fresh and all of our other sushi was creative and delicious as well. Also, everything came out in a timely manner which we appreciate. We will definitely be back!

Came on a Thursday night around 5:30pm. Was already busy but plenty of parking and they have an extra dining room up front so they can accommodate a lot of folks. 

Greeted soon after arriving, seated and brought water immediately. They give you chips, small bowls of refried beans and an excellent house made salsa with nice big chunks of tomato. 

I'm a sucker for a salsa bar and they deliver! Five kinds of salsa from mild to very hot. I like heat and the hot was serious as was the very hot - use with caution. I liked that they have different kinds - one of the hot was a verde with cilantro and roasted peppers, another was more jalapeño, another a red sauce, just a great variety.

Horchata is made in house and had a good taste - excellent for cooling off from the salsas. I had the two sopes and they can do  one of each flavor. The chorizo and potato was delicious and well flavored. The steak was nicely spiced but a bit overcooked at too low a temperature - you want more grilled flavor and some crispy bits, but it was fine.  I was very disappointed with the mass of the sope itself - I wanted it grilled and crispy but it was undercooked, not crispy and tasted like it was frozen, not a good flavor.

I wanted to try the pozole but they don't do a cup, only the large portion.

Service was excellent, friendly and efficient. Overall a great choice for a tasty Mexican feast.
A family favorite for pizza. The wood fired wings are good too. I can't wait for the Bistro to open in the Grove.
Great and wonderful service! The food is wonderful, delicious and fresh. It was quick and the servers and owners were delightful. Nice little hole in the wall.
Get the burger! Omg... the BEST burger ever!!! We also love the bacon popcorn and the cornbread.

They have reopened after Covid shut down.  They currently are not doing the senior Wednesday or taco Tuesday as they need to recoup some of their losses. They have their full menu and They have assured me the will no longer use animal lard in the refried beans. They have super yummy margaritas too!

Went today for lunch, had great service from Thomas B. (Name according to my receipt). The tables were socially distant and the server and staff was very attentive, checking in on us throughout our meal. Food was really good and came out to our table quickly. Only improve might be the music volume was a tad high, but even so it is not reason enough to not come back. :-)

Highly recommend! The "garlic cheesy bread" with the meaty red sauce is amazing. I buy the sauce à la carte to take home and make spaghetti. The "Krabby crab puffs" is probably one of the best things on an amazing menu. The after effects were all containers literally licked clean!

Ashley was awesome. Super fast, attentive and friendly! 

Chef Chris kept it entertaining and made sure we had everything we needed!

Great experience. We'll be back soon!
Stopped here as our first cheesesteak experience in Philly and wasn't too impressed. Steak was a little thick and bread was a bit tough.
Wonderful atmosphere and food to match! What a lovely night in SB....dinner was perfect.

So the office got tacos here today and all I can say is OMG! Reno has some amazing Taco place and I think I found my new favorite. We ordered all the Tacos, chips and salsa and guac. Everything was beyond excellent. Had it for lunch and taking the wife there for dinner. Oh and the tacos are huge for $1.99. Amazing place, now I just need to try some more of the menu. There is always 2moro!

This was a welcome surprise. My husband and I wanted a late lunch and they were  open. Not only were they accommodating but super welcoming. I had the most wonderful butternut squash soup and a chicken and mushroom dish (not Marsala) and my man had a fantastic mushroom and cream dish with amazing homemade pasta. The staff were lovey - so much so we made reservations for our upcoming Valentines Day dinner. Please support this fab restaurant. They deserve it.
Good food, good drinks, and fun games! You can win cute prizes for not too much money. Most of the people who work here are nice :)

This is not a gluten free facility it is vegan. It keeps coming up a gluten free and recommended. For those who are gluten free, celiac or gluten allergy there are no options. This is a. Great place for vegans. For those who are celiac or gluten free try Soy Cafe or Dolivia

Welcome to the neighborhood!!  We are locals, living in a near by condominium and are very excited to have a interesting and enjoyable restaurant within walking distance. We went last night for the first time with friends who had been there the week before.  We were sat immediately, waiter was attentive and pleasant. We shared a bottle of the Muscadet, which lived up to its reputation.  My husband and I enjoyed the escargots, some of the best I have had in Philadelphia.  Our table had a rainbow trout, steak and assorted appetizers.  We are already planning on what to order at our next visit. Mary Ann L.

Had the cheesesteak pizza tonight with some fries!!! Pizza was awesome and the crust was nice and soft, not overcook. Fries were good too. Great place for pizza but I have had tons of other things there and never a bad meal!!!

First time there and pretty impressed. Small restaurant but very good food, large portions. Ordered the hibachi chicken entree - lots of chicken, well cooked and served with lots of rice and a nice veggie mix.
Great atmosphere! We sat outside... Good wine, and cheese. We also ordered the pesto with burrata. Highly recommended!

Today was a special day !  It was my and my niece's birthday celebration with our family the niners won their game and are going to the super bowl.  We were so excited having known we had our reservation at La Strada.  Then to only be greeted with what I would categorized  as very rude service from a Kimberly.  The food was average the atmosphere was amazing!  So sad that I could give a better rating.  #tableserviceisimportant

This used to be one of our favorite places to go for Mexican food. Although, after today, it was our last. We were seated right away, but I noticed the waiter and the guy that brings the chips were no where to be seen. After about 8 min. the chip guy came and then a a few minutes later the waiter, to get our drink order. We ordered 2 cokes and water, when he brought the cokes they tasted like flat water. We asked for new soda, and he stated they only had one soda machine? 
I have no idea, but I've worked in a restaurant, so if the soda is bad, you go change it. It takes a few minutes, but then maybe other customers won't get gross soda, right? The tall, bald, larger waiter of ours had no even simple courtesy. It was, are you ready? I asked how the enchiladas are, and he said OK, and what would you like with that. I ordered the enchiladas Mexicanas, and we also ordered the quesadilla fajita. During our wait for the food we saw no one. No one to refill the water, no one to switch up chips, no one to come and take an order for the cheese dip that we were going to get, NOTHING! I was still holding out hope. When the food finally came after about 30 minutes(which is not terrible, but longer usual), I assumed that I would be eating it and I could let everything else slide. I took one bite into the enchiladas and it tasted like tunafish this is supposed to be chicken enchiladas covered in queso dip. I could immediately tell that this was canned chicken, and not good canned chicken f

Ordered a chicken quesadilla and queso. Received chips with no salsa (usually you get salsa with your chips?) Dry and bland chicken that was not warm and cheese was not melted. $18 total for this meal and it's barely edible. $9 for a quesadilla??
Really great food and nice workers. Would definitely recommend for a bang for your buck!

Upon my third visit to Art's Skillet, I am not sure if I will return.  Especially after a couple of observations and experiences when visiting.

The 2 stars are for the servers that I have encountered that were always attentive and good.   

Food:  The food is decent.

Pancakes:  I have had better pancakes elsewhere
Biscuits:  They remind me of the frozen biscuits that you pop in the oven to cook from GFS.  My dad used to bring them home when he worked there so I am pretty familiar with that taste.  I prefer to make biscuits from scratch.  
Egg Skillets:  Probably about the best offering they have.   The potatoes are not freshly cut, more from frozen so they do crisp up well and reheat well in an airfryer.
Fried Chicken:  I was not a fan.  
Burger:  Pretty good. 

Staff:  This is where I struggle with my review.   It seems if you go about an hour before closing,  they are already working on closing up the place.  Working previously in this type of industry,  I believe that putting the chairs up on the table way too early for closing does not set a idea atmosphere to eat.

Also, after a hiccup with the order with my dining companion,  I told the sever that I would take the incorrect order while the corrected order was put in.  My companion ordered the meat skillet without veggies.  Instead my companion received a meat skillet with only veggies and no meat.  The  manager on duty (Art's wife?) assumed that I expected the incorrect order for free and sent the server over to pick

Hyperbole and lengthy preambles aside, the underlying theme of Devil's Acre is unquestionably quality and consistency.  Particularly with restaurant reviews I'm usually a miserable bastard with picking places apart but there was truly nothing to even remotely dissect with yesterday's dinner here.

Service:  We were seated immediately without issue.  The hostess was nice enough and kudos to her for cleaning and dusting things nearly the entire time when she wasn't seating or helping people.  No doubt that has a lot to do with why the place looks spotless.

Our server was perfect.  Refills were well timed, dirty plates never sat around and he did a great job explaining specials/menu items that we had questions.  Completely chill and laid back vibe which works great here.

Food:  The pretzel bites are simply bitchin'.  You only get six but they are nicely salted and the accompanying cheddar wiz dip is almost like a beer cheese soup in terms of flavor and texture.  It would be criminal not to order this as an app.

The menu has lots of solid and mouth watering options but we both went for the crab cakes which were an amazing choice.  These are on par with anything you would find on the Eastern Shore but the surprising kick is the asparagus/corn fricassee.  I personally hate asparagus but whatever magic the kitchen did to it made it work because it was delicious.

Drinks:  The list of adult libations here gets its own menu because it is extensive.  Pineapple Hard Cider from a comp

Really small portions, but tastes good. Very neat looking inside. Took about 25 minutes to get our receipt despite being the only ones in there. Waiter also awkwardly stood there while we tipped and signed 3 separate checks with one pen and collected them. Was a bit odd.

Amongst a deadly virus that could kill us all, MURDER hornets, UFOs, and God knows what else, quarantine is a thing of the past here at Tony's. Very few things are open despite a clear demand, and Tony's has not only delivered, but delivered the sun, moon, and stars since the world has ended. Good food. Strong, but delicious drinks. Very friendly staff. I am thrilled to have found Tony's. You should find them too.

I was really excited to come back to this place after a year of traveling, but it wasn't nearly as good as it was the first time. Not sure if the pandemic had anything to do with the lack of quality, but this was the driest brisket I have ever had. The carver pulled off all the burnt part before slicing.. or chopping? I can't really tell.. the burnt fatty is all the flavor.. the cornbread was like eating a dried flavorless sponge. The corn pudding, collard greens and pork were mediocre. I don't know if it was just a bad day but this went from my favorite brisket to the worst I have ever had. Highly disappointed and shows that their food quality is different each time you go. I hope that if you go, it's on a good brisket day.

My favorite chain restaurant ever (and I'm picky) so naturally I came today for my birthday and manager Ryan made me love this place even more. So professional and nice.
Best things to try: avocado egg-rolls!!!
I ordered the cheesesteak fries  and really enjoyed  it. Small portion was just right go lunch.

Hot cider and makers mark
Chablis
Mango whango beer
Mediterranean plate (pricy at $18, but hummus was very good)
Tinga Tacos (shredded chicken with radish and cilantro and served with sour cream and salsa). Needed some heat. 
French grilled cheese and baked potato soup. Sandwich was grilled Brie and green apple. Soup was total comfort food. 

$75. 

Excellent service. Eat at 3 diff restaurants (indoor mall area next to Doylestown bookstore) Drink from Hops and Scotch (also take out cocktails)
3 restaurants are:
PA Soup & Seafood House 
Andre's wine and cheese shop
Sputino wood fired Pizza

Multiple seating. Inside and outside. Live music outside. Fast service. We will come again.

I've been coming here for years, love the food, the speed, consistency, and the service! I also live they open very late. The beef Sharerma has improved dramatically. Though the boneless chicken wings are not chicken wings anymore, lol. My 1 complaint is that they don't let you leave credit card tips - I never understand why restraunts do this. Pay waiters the same and leave us tip them when they go above and beyond!!! Will update to 5 when they change that cause the people who work here are some of the best I've seen in the fast food business - so kudos to the manager too, they must be doing something right! But let us TIP!

Hmmmm..... Where do I start? I got the french dip garlic aioli sandwich... It has absolutely no flavor, like at all. The dip is supposed to be rich and flavorful and it just looks like they put brown food coloring in water.  I don't even think they put the aioli on my sandwich. The club soda with lime was the best thing.

Pretty decent little place! Food is good, prices are reasonable, outdoor seating is great! 
Parking is a hassle and it's CROWDED inside, but that's probably because it's one of the few non-chain places in the 'Ville.
The filet and the dark-n-stormy are always on point!

I decided to try Okinii during the COVID shutdown, so I ordered takeout. I was very excited to try it for the first time. I got my salad dressing and there was a BUG IN MY DRESSING. Dead. Floating on the top. I completely lost my appetite. Not only was there a bug in my food, my food was so cold and not very good at all. I will not go back.

I've only been here for their drinks until recently. I tried their butter chicken wrap and was pleasantly surprised by the quality - nicely flavoured food with chicken and everything that is consistently "spread out" through the entire wrap.. Also, their second floor is quite nice.

Lochel's is a very good family bakery with nearly anything you could want. Everything looked delicious. They take precautions for Covid and have plexiglass/lucite between the customer and the staff.  They have a variety of cookies, cakes, pies, cupcakes, sticky buns, among many delicious looking desserts. Everything is reasonably priced. Their cupcakes are excellent and didn't disappoint. They have a variety of icings and cakes. The presentation is as good as they taste. The cheese danish was good with great tasting cheese and just the right amount of icing. However, the cheese danishes at Weinrich's Bakery are the best around- packed with cheese. Lochel's is a couple steps behind, but the quality of the cheese is very good. The cupcake award goes to Lochel's. I would definitely go back to the bakery, where the service is cordial and the staff are courteous.

Mouth is still drooling from this meal. Between my husband and me we had to order another round of oysters after we had one order because they were so good - you have to get them!! Idk what they do different but keep it up, best oysters in Indy. Drinks - they know how to make them and make them stiff. I had a lemon drop and dirty martini, they do not skimp on the vodka (thank you for that!!), my husband loves their old fashions he got two of those as well.

For our meal we split the lobster Mac (amazing) then we both got shrimp and lobster sliders.

Doesn't save much but  - if you both want sliders and Mac - makes most sense to order sliders and then get lobster Mac (bigger, split worthy amount) vs the deal two sliders and Mac. 

Ended with the bread pudding, again one of the best in Indy (I get bread pudding usually if it's on any menu).

Worth every penny.

Perfect for a date night, after work drinks, has a great vibe to it. Definitely dress more formal and enjoy 

We actually will be back this Thursday to celebrate my husbands birthday! Can't wait

I rarely give out 5 stars and lets say for "diner" food this was awesome.  My BLT was amazing and my Husbands burger was pretty tasty too.  The sundaes were delicious but the service was outstanding!!  A must do in STL
Asked for crispy wings but instead I got chewy skin. Terrible. Only my second order but for sure my last.

I love this place and stop in at least once a month to buy uncooked blue crabs. I have always received wonderful customer service from everyone working there. I think it's at a point where they know me by now!  I have never been disappointed with the size of the crabs I request and their prices are fair for the area. I would highly recommend this market for your blue crab fix!

We have been going to the Stadium for years. Wings are great, service pretty good and most of the food we order is pretty good. 
The problem is some customers ignore the posting on the doors and written in large letters on two chalkboards stating that you need a mask to come on and if you get up from your table you need to wear a mask. We counted 10 people walking in, going to use the restroom or walking by us leaving without a mask. NO one took the time to remind them to put a mask on. One lady pulled her vest over her mouth walking out others didn't bother. 
I didn't see the owner there last night so that may be why no one said anything. I am sure they don't want to chase away paying customers but does anyone want to catch Covid? 
Here is the question , do we stop going until the pandemic is under control, or do we ask the person on charge to tell people a mask is required?  We didn't say anything because we didn't want to cause a scene.
